S0 limitation: Metadata does not verify synchronization, frozen frames, or complete decode integrity.

Stage A tank: All prepared tank images were visually reviewed: 36 discrete timestamps from 0.0 through 17.5 at 0.5-second spacing. No continuous video or audio was reviewed. The original is 18.456667 seconds long, but the configured analysis interval is 0.0–18.0. There is no prepared image at 18.0, and 17.5–18.0 is unobserved beyond its first instant. Every intersample gap can hide fast actions, exact activation/death timing, hits or eliminations. Contact-sheet scaling limits small HUD and kill-feed text; three key images were checked at original resolution. No full kill-feed reconstruction, precise damage accounting or unseen ability identification is claimed. Camera occlusion and visual effects obscure actors. Health changes alone do not identify their sources. No other POV/report was read, and global teamfight outcome remains unknown. No conflicting evidence was established from this single sampled source; this does not resolve cross-POV conflicts.

Stage A dps1: All supplied frames were directly inspected: 0.0–17.5 seconds inclusive at 0.5-second spacing. These are discrete observations; cited windows identify the sampled evidence span and do not attest to continuous inspection. Every interval between frames remains unsampled, and 17.5–18.0 seconds has no supplied endpoint frame. Fast abilities and exact event timing may be missed. Effects, weapon models, and overlapping characters obscure some targets. HUD values were used only where legible. Broadcast information may exceed player knowledge. Audio was not supplied or inspected. The original video was not opened and its supplied hash was not independently verified.

Stage A dps2: All supplied timestamps were inspected: 0.0–17.5 seconds at 0.5-second increments. These are discrete observations, not continuous video review. Fast abilities and intervening movement may be missed. No image covers 18.0 seconds. Bright effects, overlapping characters, and broadcast overlays limit interpretation. Hero, map identity, ability names, and several damage/healing sources remain unknown. Audio was not supplied or inspected. The supplied video hash is recorded from the configuration and was not independently recalculated. human_evidence_audit: PENDING.

Stage A support1: All 36 attached images were directly inspected at 0.5-second intervals from 0.0 through 17.5 seconds. The intervals between images were not continuously reviewed, and 17.5–18.0 seconds has no supplied visual coverage. Fast abilities and brief events may be absent from the samples. Bright combat effects and cover obscure some targets and labels. HUD health, ammunition, ultimate charge, objective percentages and the final kill feed are sufficiently legible for the stated observations. Exact ability identities and the map name remain uncertain. Audio was not supplied or inspected. The provided video path and hash were not independently verified. No other POV, report or file was accessed. Denser inspection of the original recording is recommended for 9.0–17.5 seconds before attributing individual abilities or damage sequences.

Stage A support2: All attached frames were inspected at timestamps 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0, 6.5, 7.0, 7.5, 8.0, 8.5, 9.0, 9.5, 10.0, 10.5, 11.0, 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, 14.0, 14.5, 15.0, 15.5, 16.0, 16.5, 17.0 and 17.5 seconds. Event windows group these discrete samples and do not establish continuous inspection. Every inter-frame gap and 17.5–18.0 seconds remain uninspected. Fast actions may be missed. Effects, overlapping characters and cover limit target and impact identification. Original video access and hash verification were not performed. No audio was supplied or inspected.
